Why MDL

Content stays close to the idea

MDL gives each page a clear outline, then compiles it into semantic HTML with predictable classes. Designers still own the CSS, and developers can add JavaScript only where behavior belongs.

Structure

Pages read like outlines

Use sections such as page, topbar, hero, grid, card, form, and footer to describe the site shape directly.

Styling

CSS remains normal

The compiler emits stable mdl-* classes, so the visual system lives in one familiar stylesheet.

Behavior

Scripts are explicit

Attach event handlers with attributes like @click(showPlan) and export the matching function from a module.

Workflow

From draft to production preview

  1. Author

    Write content in MDL with Markdown, dot inline elements, attributes, and named sections.

  2. Style

    Use the generated classes as hooks for responsive layout, controls, cards, banners, and forms.

  3. Ship

    Run mdl build to compile every page under the project pages folder into static HTML.
